import importlib.util, itertools, string, json
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('codec','/inputs/codec.py'); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
f=m.canonicalize_url
alpha=string.ascii_letters+' %'
w=None
for n in range(1,33):
    for t in itertools.product(alpha,repeat=n):
        x=''.join(t)
        if f(f(x))!=f(x): w=x;break
    if w: break
once=f(w); twice=f(once)
print(repr(w),repr(once),repr(twice))
assert once!=twice
json.dump({"input":w,"once":once,"twice":twice},open('/work/counterexample.json','w'))
d=json.load(open('/work/counterexample.json')); print(open('/work/counterexample.json').read(), d==({"input":w,"once":f(w),"twice":f(f(w))}))
